custodian._instruction: Add all parties that fulfill the role of a custodian for the service, typically an organization.

deploymentProtocol._instruction: Add the protocol or workflow recipe that should be used to deploy this service.

description._instruction: Enter a description (or abstract) of this service.

feature._instruction: Add the main features of this service.

fullDocumentation._instruction: Add the publication or file that acts as the full documentation of this service.

fullName._instruction: Enter a descriptive full name (or title) for this service.

funding._instruction: Add all funding information of this service.

howToCite._instruction: Enter the preferred citation text for this service.

keyword._instruction: Add all relevant keywords to this service, either by adding controlled terms or by suggesting new terms.

relatedPublication._instruction: Add all further publications besides the full documentation that provide the original context for the production of this service (e.g., an original research article describing the service).

scope._instruction: Add the scope of this service, i.e., what analysis methods does it perform, what kinds of experimental data is it intended for.

shortName._instruction: Enter a short name (or alias) for this service that could be used as a shortened display title.

supportChannel._instruction: Enter all channels through which a user can receive support for using this service.
